nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the mug been moved toward and to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Complete if the mug has been moved from its source position and is to the right of the headphones in the edited image. Partial if there is visible progress moving the mug toward the right of the headphones but it has not reached a position to their right. Absent if there is no visible progress toward that requested placement. Unknown if the images do not provide sufficient evidence to assess the mug's movement and placement. Do not count merely finding a mug to the right as progress unless the images support that it is the mug being moved; do not require that no duplicate or remnant be visible.
nodes.binding: The mug in the source image and the headphones in the source and edited images; assess the requested mug placement by comparing source and edited images.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
